zh.title: 國防部：中共10架次軍機出海 6架跨越台海中線
zh.summary: 國防部指出，中共10架次戰機出海，其中6架次逾越海峽中線進入北部及中部空域。
body: 國防部於8月15日下午表示，自當日上午8時28分起，陸續偵獲中共殲11、殲轟7及蘇愷30等各型主輔戰機計10架次出海。其中6架次逾越海峽中線，進入台灣北部及中部空域，配合中共軍艦執行所謂「聯合戰備警巡」，對台灣周邊海空域進行騷擾。
國防部指出，國軍運用聯合情監偵手段嚴密掌握相關動態，並檢派任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統進行適切應處。此外，國軍年度「漢光42號」實兵演習於8月14日落幕，演習自8月5日至14日共實施10天9夜。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 10 PLA Aircraft Near Island, 6 Crossing Strait Median Line
en.summary: Taiwan detected 10 PLA aircraft operating around the island, with 6 crossing the Taiwan Strait median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 15 that starting from 8:28 AM, 10 sorties of Chinese military aircraft were detected operating off the island. The aircraft types included J-11, JH-7, and Su-30 fighters. Among them, 6 sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering airspace over northern and central Taiwan in coordination with Chinese naval vessels during a joint combat readiness patrol.

The defense ministry stated that Taiwan's military closely monitored the situation using joint intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance assets, dispatching mission aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile systems to respond appropriately. The activity occurred immediately after Taiwan concluded its 10-day Han Kuang 42 live-fire military exercise on August 14.
